optimizedDescription.value: Governed CLI lifecycle transitions with Core-resolved routing, validity recovery, hooks, progress, and repair diagnostics.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change Transition
## Rules
- Commands: `specd changes transition <name> <step> ...` or `--next`; alias `specd change transition`. `<name>` required; `<step>` required unless mutually exclusive `--next`. Options: `--skip-hooks <source.pre,source.post,target.pre,target.post,all>`, `--allow-out-of-scope`, `--format text|json|toon`.
- `--next` passes `to: 'next'`; Core resolves happy-path state. CLI never keeps routing table or uses `GetStatus.nextAction` as resolver. Core rejection from no-auto-hop states exits 1 with explanatory stderr `error:`.
- Consume canonical `GetStatus`/`TransitionChange` validity results before `next` and after reconciled failure. Automatic recovery output shows actual state, invalidated evidence, reason, next action: stale required spec approval routes through `designing`/`ready`; stale sign-off alone to `done`; stale verification recommends in-place verification only at required boundary. Never retry, select alternate transition, expose attempt restart, accept `verifying → verifying`, or claim attempt completion. Entry to `verifying` reports readiness; exit to `done` reports `verification.current`.
- Never call `RefreshImplementationTracking`/`ImplementationDetector`. Pre-transition and repair `GetStatus` use `refreshImplementationTracking: false`; `TransitionChange` retains default refresh.
- No approval flags to `TransitionChange.execute`; kernel uses `config.approvals`. Never rewrite logical target for approval/sign-off; failed gates stay `ready`/`done`.
- `--allow-out-of-scope` sets `allowOutOfScope: true` only for `impl.linksInScope`, never `impl.filesResolved`; omission leaves field unset. `--skip-hooks` maps to `skipHookPhases`; `all` delegates manual `change run-hooks`.
- Default effects: source.post hooks → target.pre hooks → transition; fail-fast. Hook failure exits 2, stderr `error:`, no Repair Guide.
- Pass `onProgress`. Text uses generic check bus: `check-start`, optional `check-progress`, `check-done`; hooks appear as `Running pre hooks`/`Running post hooks`; render `<label> (<id>)`, lines, then `✓ <label>` or `✗ <label>: <reason>`; never `Executing:`. Keep in-flight hook output visible even on failure. `change transition` never emits public `hook-progress`; `run-hooks` may retain its presenter.
- JSON/TOON emit stdout NDJSON records, all `stream: "change-transition"`; terminal `event.type: "complete"`. Success result: `result`, `name`, `from`, `to`; failure: `result: "failure"`, `name`, `from`, `to`, `blockers`, `nextAction`.
- Text success prints final confirmation stdout after stderr progress. Invalid transition, unsatisfied requires, incomplete tasks, or rejected `next`: exit 1, stderr `error:`; incomplete tasks name artifact.
- Text repair-guide errors use canonical `GetStatus` transition-check blockers/nextAction on stderr: `! <CODE> — <label>: <message>` or unlabeled `! <CODE>: <message>` plus target/command/reason. Surface human-gate reason. Never recompute diagnostics in CLI.
## Constraints
- Help exposes logical target, never routing.
- `HookFailedError` is not repair-guide error.
- Text: progress stderr, confirmation stdout. JSON/TOON: structured stream stdout; stderr only non-structured diagnostics.
